phrase.en: Is the tip included in the bill?
phrase.es: ¿La propina está incluida en la cuenta?

text.ru: «Включено ли» — пассив: be + 3-я форма — Is breakfast included? Is the tip included? «Доплата» — an extra charge.
text.en: For “is it included?” use the passive: be + past participle — Is breakfast included? An extra charge is money you pay on top.
text.es: «¿Está incluido?» — pasiva be + participio: Is breakfast included? an extra charge — un cargo adicional.

examples.en: Breakfast is included in the price.
Is there an extra charge for parking?

exercises.en: There is an extra charge for the tip.
